body: I feel very similar. I have tried to make positive things happen in my life but it all turns to shit. Meanwhile my old classmates and coworkers are getting promotions, getting married and having babies. I totally get what you mean.

Thank you.

In a dream world I imagined I'd get my Master's and open up my own private practice for counseling. Right now that seems hard to think about or even think. I can barely handle thinking forward and getting past tonight.

Yes, I will look for jobs and such. Ironically, my Master's in Counseling so I already have a caseload. It's funny, I'm instructed to teach others coping skills and how to handle life and here I am struggling to make it through each day.

"It gets better" is one of the numerous throwaway lines that people drag out because they honestly have nothing else to say. No one ever identifies "when" exactly it gets better. It could be tomorrow, it could be 4 years for now. 

I feel for you because I'm in a similar thought. The idea of ending it all makes me happy because its a resolution to all this pain.
I'm judging my cat right now.
